content_blocks.label: clause_1._Premises
content_blocks.text: The Landlord hereby leases to the Tenant the Premises, hereinafter defined as the building located at 123 Main Street, Springfield, State of Novaria.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Term_of_Lease
content_blocks.text: The Term of this Lease shall commence on April 1, 2024, and shall terminate on March 31, 2029, unless earlier terminated as provided herein.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Rental_Payment
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay the Rent to the Landlord in advance on the first day of each month in the amount of $5,000.00, payable to the order of Jameson Properties LLC.
